connectorUiConfig.title: Bob Security Unified Agent Risk
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Bob Security](https://bobsecurity.com) connector pushes normalized agent risk alerts directly into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Events are written to the `UnifiedAgentRisk_CL` table.

graphQueries.metricName: Total unified agent risk events received

sampleQueries.description: Get the latest Bob Security unified agent risk events
sampleQueries.query:
UnifiedAgentRisk_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

dataTypes.name: UnifiedAgentRisk_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
UnifiedAgentRisk_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Microsoft Entra
customs.description: Permission to create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID. Typically requires the Entra ID Application Developer role or higher.

customs.name: Microsoft Azure
customs.description: Permission to assign the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the data collection rule (DCR). Typically requires Azure RBAC Owner or User Access Administrator role.

customs.name: Bob Security
customs.description: Permission to configure Microsoft Sentinel as a push destination in Bob Security.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create Azure resources and provide the required permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables Bob Security to push unified agent risk alerts directly to Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated configuration and secure data ingestion with a Microsoft Entra application
Selecting **Deploy push connector resources** creates the `UnifiedAgentRisk_CL` Log Analytics table, a data collection rule (DCR), and a data collection endpoint (DCE). It also creates a Microsoft Entra application, grants it access to the DCR, and configures a client secret so Bob Security can send events securely.

parameters.label: Deploy push connector resources
parameters.applicationDisplayName: Bob Security Unified Agent Risk Connector

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure Microsoft Sentinel as a destination in Bob Security
instructionSteps.description: Configure Bob Security to send flat JSON records that follow the Unified Agent Risk schema. Use OAuth 2.0 client credentials and the values provided below.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Bob Security solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables push-based ingestion of unified agent risk alerts into the UnifiedAgentRisk_CL table.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API

  2. Azure Monitor data collection rules

Data Connectors: 1

Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel | Learn more about Solutions
